The project builds successfully. Here's what was created:

**Project structure:**
- `Models/Recipe.cs` — `Recipe` and `RecipeSubmission` models
- `Services/RecipeService.cs` — Singleton service with 10 seed recipes across 5 categories (Italian, Indian, Mexican, Asian, Desserts)
- `Components/Pages/HomePage.razor` — Category cards with emoji flags and recipe counts
- `Components/Pages/Category.razor` — Browse recipes in a category (read-only, SSR)
- `Components/Pages/RecipeDetail.razor` — Full recipe view with ingredients + steps
- `Components/StarRating.razor` — Interactive `@rendermode InteractiveServer` click-to-rate widget (1–5 stars)
- `Components/Pages/SubmitRecipe.razor` — Interactive form with `EditForm` (title, category, ingredients, steps)

**Render mode strategy:** Most pages use static SSR (read-only). Only `StarRating` and `SubmitRecipe` use `@rendermode InteractiveServer` for click handling and form state.

Run with `cd RecipeCommunity && dotnet run`.
